The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.014), which favours a robust combination.
